data.name: Ansraj
data.gender_notes: Ansraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansraj is derived from Sanskrit, where An means 'Lord' and Sraj means 'Treasury'. This name signifies the one who is the guardian of wealth, both material and spiritual. In Hindu mythology, Ansraj is the name of a deity who is believed to be the treasurer of the gods. The name Ansraj carries the meaning “Lord's treasury” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord's treasury and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Custodian of divine blessings and prosperity.
data.etymology: Ansraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord's treasury.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

People with this name are often seen as being in charge of finances, possessions, or careers. In some communities, this name is also given to the eldest male member of the family, symbolizing his role as the family's provider and protector.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Ansraj is a reminder of the importance of being a good steward of the resources we have been given. It is believed that by taking care of our material wealth, we are able to tap into a deeper spiritual wealth - the peace and contentment that comes from living a simple, giving, and gratitude-filled life.
